subject: Andriy Shevchenko
title: The VHS tape that bought Shevchenko

lines.vo: Milan once bought a striker after watching a VHS tape.
lines.footage: Shevchenko Barcelona 1997 Camp Nou hat-trick highlights

lines.vo: Dynamo Kyiv won four-nil at Barcelona. Shevchenko scored a hat-trick.
Milan's scouts were absent. Their director ordered a recording instead. Peak scouting: press play.
lines.footage: retro newsroom VHS archive and Milan unveiling footage

lines.vo: Price: about forty-five billion lire. Roughly twenty-four million dollars. No late fees.
In 2003-04: twenty-four Serie A goals and the Ballon d'Or. The tape was right.
Chelsea paid thirty point eight million pounds in 2006. He scored twenty-two goals in seventy-seven games. Be kind, rewind.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.
